verdict.rationale: Sentry ships a built-in AI agent, Seer, which its homepage says can find root causes and generate merge-ready patches. That is a real delegable task inside the product, but the evidence is only two marketing lines. The Agent Tracing docs cover monitoring the user's own agents and do not count toward this story. missing for 10: first-party docs on how users invoke and delegate tasks to Seer, scope of delegable tasks beyond debugging/fixing, workflow and approval details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
